Finding 1 [high · Reliability · REL09-BP01] The S3 Tables bucket `lakehouse-prod` (140 tables) has backup "none" and no cross-region replication, while the NFR RPO is 1440 minutes. Identify and back up the data, or be able to reproduce it from sources, within the RPO and RTO [S1]. Already recorded as finding #1.

Finding 2 [high · Operational Excellence · OPS10-BP01] Glue has `failure_alerts: false` and `max_retries: 0`, and all 30 concurrent nightly jobs start at 02:00 UTC. Failures are not alerted and not retried. The best practice asks for a defined event and incident process with alerts owned by a team [S6]. Alerts that notify on threshold breaches are part of the same gap [S9].

Finding 3 [medium · Security · SEC08-BP02] Athena `query_results_encrypted` is false, and the bucket uses SSE-S3. Enforce encryption at rest for stored data, and use customer managed keys where fine-grained key control is needed [S15]. Encryption at rest is a core control [S12].

Finding 4 [medium · Performance Efficiency] No gap found in what was retrieved. The retrieved PERF03-BP04 text recommends partitioning, columnar formats and query tuning [S20]. The architecture does not state whether these are in place, so I cannot confirm a gap. Athena has no per-query bytes-scanned cutoff, which is covered under Cost below.

Finding 5 [medium · Cost Optimization · COST03-BP05] No budget alerts are recorded for the USD 8,000 monthly budget, and Athena has no bytes-scanned cutoff per query. The best practice asks for notifications when cost exceeds defined limits, using AWS Budgets or Cost Anomaly Detection [S22]. AWS Budgets is recommended on workload accounts [S25].

Finding 6 [medium · Sustainability · SUS04-BP03] Raw-layer retention is "none", so the raw data is never deleted or moved to a cheaper tier. Lifecycle policies should transition, archive or delete datasets according to their retention needs [S26]. Snapshot expiration of 7 days is already set [S26 does not cover this value; it is a setting of the architecture].
